correction.comparisonBaseline: The cursor feature-policy correction relative to the already committed posted dispatcher; not a claim that the cumulative Issue71 native lifecycle diff is empty.

nativeTranscriptFieldDefinitions.disableTypingHide: Whether the probe added an extra process-scoped feature override. False does not negate the feature policy embedded in the candidate executable.
nativeTranscriptFieldDefinitions.after-enter: Historical activation-stage label in the probe. inputMode identifies the actual activation, including ButtonSpace.

checklistPresented: Release Ctrl+Shift+O; filter Enter, Browse-button Enter, Browse-button Space, physical mouse activation
Empty and PDF-open windows; select, cancel button, Escape, reopen and returned keyboard control
Two windows; picker belongs to initiating window and control returns there
operatorAcceptance.interpretation: Operator reported that the presented checklist worked on the launched production candidate.
operatorAcceptance.limitation: This is manual attestation, not an uploaded cursor-inclusive recording or an automated measurement of every physical input.

causalComparison.limitation: GetCursorInfo flags and SendInput are not physical displayed-cursor proof.

packagedFixtureQa.screenshotLimitation: This native app screenshot proves fixture rendering after dismissal, not hardware/remote cursor visibility.

cursorVideoQa.observed: Verified owned picker stayed active during recording; flags remained 1, a visible arrow appears in the recording, and one Escape returned native focus to the owner. Both runs closed their owned app normally.
cursorVideoQa.capture: FFmpeg gdigrab draw_mouse=1, exact owner HWND, top 320x100 pixels, 10fps, two seconds; no folder-list capture.
cursorVideoQa.limitation: Synthetic keyboard/pointer input and OS-composited cursor recording on the state-isolated QA build. This supplements, rather than replaces, operator acceptance of the production candidate and is not remote-client hardware capture.

reviewRepairs.qaConfigurationDelta: Unique identifier only; nested lifecycle testing additionally enables a temporary loopback debugger and owned browser profile.

composition.before: Four real-DOM cases reproduced unintended Browse invocation for legacy keyCode 229 and AltGraph Enter at filter/button targets.
composition.fix: Reuse isNativeCompositionEvent at the existing Browse capture-keydown boundary; no keyup latch or timing change.

windowCloseOwnership.before: Closing owner A while B's picker was active left native IPC responsive but disposed B's frontend coordinator, preventing a fresh Browse. The production-registration test reproduced teardown in both windows.
windowCloseOwnership.cause: Tauri Any listeners receive targeted events too; the global window-close-requested subscription crossed window ownership.
windowCloseOwnership.fix: Use getCurrentWindow().listen only for window-close-requested. Intentionally global state/quit events remain global.
windowCloseOwnership.observed: Both HWND-owned native pickers ran on the same UI thread. A was destroyed while inner B remained live; unrelated native IPC completed during nested Show and after inner dismissal. B regained native and DOM focus, admitted no tab/recent, reopened a fresh picker through its production keyboard route, cancelled it, and exited normally.

currentFixture.screenshotScope: Approved fixture region cropped to exclude an unrelated desktop taskbar preview; the generated full frame was discarded.

currentCursor.observed: Cursor flags remained 1 and the inspected recording frame contains the visible arrow while the Enter-opened native picker is active.
currentCursor.observerDelta: Only the diagnostic thread uses per-monitor-aware physical coordinates for matching the capture region; no app or OS preference is changed.
currentCursor.limitation: Injected input and OS cursor composition, not remote-client hardware capture. An earlier crop omitted the pointer due to observer coordinates and is not used as visible-cursor proof.

verification.recovery: Bounded concurrency resolved Windows paging-file exhaustion and a fixture timeout without weakening assertions, test timeouts or warnings. Relocated generated target metadata was cleaned. A later native archive hit disk exhaustion; removing only this worktree's generated incremental cache and disabling incremental compilation for the successful rerun resolved it.

retainedFailures: An early probe used a stale process MainWindowHandle for picker ownership; its failed record remains retained.
Some injected-input trials stopped when the app did not acquire or retain foreground ownership; they are not passing native cases.

An initial fixture probe observed native mouse capture: first Escape released capture but left the picker open. That intermediate result is not treated as successful dismissal; its process was subsequently closed. A later verified run had no capture and dismissed with one Escape.

An initial screenshot included a native folder list. The generated full frame was discarded and only an app-header crop retained privately; the published fixture screenshot is the verified post-dismissal frame.
releaseBoundary: No broader parity, release or merge approval is asserted by this evidence record.
